description: Ultra-min package-only variant of the BCJ-filtered old sidecar score leader. Payload filenames are reduced to one character and the wrapper is shortened; decoded cmix and dictionary payloads are preserved.

build.packaging: Ultra-min Python wrapper with one-character payload files.

basis: Same BCJ-filtered executable payload and same cmix-compressed dictionary as the parent package; only wrapper and file names changed.
deps: C++ runtime for the bundled cmix/fx2 binary
